summary: McGraw Hill's grade 8 course in the Reveal Math middle-school series, in 11 modules and 57 lessons. It covers exponents and scientific notation, real and irrational numbers, multi-step equations, slope and linear relationships, functions, systems of equations, angle relationships and the Pythagorean Theorem, transformations, congruence and similarity, volume of curved solids, and bivariate data.

toc.label: Module 1
toc.title: Exponents and Scientific Notation
toc.covers: Integer exponents, exponent properties, and computing with numbers in scientific notation.

children.title: Powers and Exponents
children.covers: Writing and evaluating powers, including negative bases.

children.title: Multiply and Divide Monomials
children.covers: Applying the product and quotient of powers properties.

children.title: Powers of Monomials
children.covers: Applying the power of a power and power of a product properties.

children.title: Zero and Negative Exponents
children.covers: Defining zero and negative exponents and simplifying with them.

children.title: Scientific Notation
children.covers: Writing very large and very small numbers in scientific notation and comparing them.

children.title: Compute with Scientific Notation
children.covers: Multiplying, dividing, adding, and subtracting numbers in scientific notation.

toc.label: Module 2
toc.title: Real Numbers
toc.covers: Repeating decimals as fractions, square and cube roots, irrational numbers, and ordering real numbers.

children.title: Terminating and Repeating Decimals
children.covers: Converting repeating decimals to fractions and classifying rational numbers.

children.title: Roots
children.covers: Finding square and cube roots and solving x^2 = p and x^3 = p.

children.title: Real Numbers
children.covers: Classifying numbers as rational or irrational within the real number system.

children.title: Estimate Irrational Numbers
children.covers: Approximating irrational numbers between integers and as decimals.

children.title: Compare and Order Real Numbers
children.covers: Comparing and ordering real numbers on a number line.

toc.label: Module 3
toc.title: Solve Equations with Variables on Each Side
toc.covers: Linear equations with variables on both sides and multi-step equations, including how many solutions an equation has.

children.title: Solve Equations with Variables on Each Side
children.covers: Collecting variable terms on one side to solve linear equations.

children.title: Write and Solve Equations with Variables on Each Side
children.covers: Writing such equations from real-world situations and solving them.

children.title: Solve Multi-Step Equations
children.covers: Solving equations that need distributing and combining like terms.

children.title: Write and Solve Multi-Step Equations
children.covers: Writing multi-step equations from context and solving them.

children.title: Determine the Number of Solutions
children.covers: Recognizing equations with one solution, no solution, or infinitely many solutions.

toc.label: Module 4
toc.title: Linear Relationships and Slope
toc.covers: How linear relationships relate to proportional ones: slope, direct variation, and slope-intercept form.

children.title: Proportional Relationships and Slope
children.covers: Graphing and comparing proportional relationships and reading the unit rate as slope.

children.title: Slope of a Line
children.covers: Finding slope from a graph, a table, and the slope formula.

children.title: Similar Triangles and Slope
children.covers: Using similar triangles to show slope is the same anywhere on a line.

children.title: Direct Variation
children.covers: Deriving y = mx from graphs, tables, and verbal descriptions of proportional relationships.

children.title: Slope-Intercept Form
children.covers: Writing linear equations in the form y = mx + b.

children.title: Graph Linear Equations
children.covers: Graphing lines in slope-intercept form and graphing vertical and horizontal lines.

toc.label: Module 5
toc.title: Functions
toc.covers: Defining functions, building and comparing linear functions, nonlinear functions, and qualitative graphs.

children.title: Identify Functions
children.covers: Deciding whether a relation is a function from mappings, tables, and graphs.

children.title: Function Tables
children.covers: Using function rules to complete input-output tables and graph them.

children.title: Construct Linear Functions
children.covers: Writing linear functions from tables, graphs, and descriptions and interpreting rate of change and initial value.

children.title: Compare Functions
children.covers: Comparing properties of two functions given in different representations.

children.title: Nonlinear Functions
children.covers: Distinguishing linear from nonlinear functions.

children.title: Qualitative Graphs
children.covers: Sketching and describing graphs that show where a function increases or decreases.

toc.label: Module 6
toc.title: Systems of Linear Equations
toc.covers: Solving two-variable linear systems by graphing, substitution, and elimination, and counting solutions.

children.title: Solve Systems of Equations by Graphing
children.covers: Finding the solution of a system as the intersection of two lines.

children.title: Determine Number of Solutions
children.covers: Using slopes and intercepts to tell whether a system has one, no, or infinitely many solutions.

children.title: Solve Systems of Equations by Substitution
children.covers: Solving systems by substituting one equation into the other.

children.title: Solve Systems of Equations by Elimination
children.covers: Solving systems by adding or subtracting equations to eliminate a variable.

children.title: Write and Solve Systems of Equations
children.covers: Writing systems from real-world problems and solving them.

toc.label: Module 7
toc.title: Triangles and the Pythagorean Theorem
toc.covers: Parallel lines and transversals, triangle angle facts, and the Pythagorean Theorem and its converse.

children.title: Angle Relationships and Parallel Lines
children.covers: Angle pairs formed when a transversal crosses parallel lines.

children.title: Angle Relationships and Triangles
children.covers: The triangle angle sum and exterior angle relationships.

children.title: The Pythagorean Theorem
children.covers: Using the Pythagorean Theorem to find missing side lengths of right triangles.

children.title: Converse of the Pythagorean Theorem
children.covers: Using the converse to test whether a triangle is a right triangle.

children.title: Distance on the Coordinate Plane
children.covers: Finding the distance between two points with the Pythagorean Theorem.

toc.label: Module 8
toc.title: Transformations
toc.covers: Translations, reflections, rotations, and dilations on the coordinate plane.

children.title: Translations
children.covers: Translating figures and describing translations with coordinate rules.

children.title: Reflections
children.covers: Reflecting figures across the axes and describing the coordinate changes.

children.title: Rotations
children.covers: Rotating figures 90, 180, and 270 degrees about the origin.

children.title: Dilations
children.covers: Enlarging and reducing figures by a scale factor centered at the origin.

toc.label: Module 9
toc.title: Congruence and Similarity
toc.covers: Congruence through rigid motions, similarity through dilations, and indirect measurement.

children.title: Congruence and Transformations
children.covers: Showing figures are congruent with a sequence of rigid motions.

children.title: Congruence and Corresponding Parts
children.covers: Using corresponding parts of congruent figures to find unknown measures.

children.title: Similarity and Transformations
children.covers: Showing figures are similar with rigid motions plus a dilation.

children.title: Similarity and Corresponding Parts
children.covers: Using proportional sides and equal angles of similar figures to find unknowns.

children.title: Indirect Measurement
children.covers: Using similar triangles to find heights and distances that cannot be measured directly.

toc.label: Module 10
toc.title: Volume
toc.covers: Volume of cylinders, cones, spheres, and composite solids, and finding missing dimensions.

children.title: Volume of Cylinders
children.covers: Finding the volume of cylinders.

children.title: Volume of Cones
children.covers: Finding the volume of cones.

children.title: Volume of Spheres
children.covers: Finding the volume of spheres and hemispheres.

children.title: Find Missing Dimensions
children.covers: Solving volume formulas for a missing radius or height.

children.title: Volume of Composite Solids
children.covers: Finding the volume of solids made of cylinders, cones, spheres, and prisms.

toc.label: Module 11
toc.title: Scatter Plots and Two-Way Tables
toc.covers: Bivariate data: scatter plots, lines of fit, and two-way tables for categorical data.

children.title: Scatter Plots
children.covers: Making scatter plots and describing association, clusters, and outliers.

children.title: Draw Lines of Fit
children.covers: Informally fitting a straight line to a scatter plot.

children.title: Equations for Lines of Fit
children.covers: Writing equations for lines of fit and interpreting slope and intercept in context.

children.title: Two-Way Tables
children.covers: Building two-way frequency tables for categorical data.

children.title: Associations in Two-Way Tables
children.covers: Using relative frequencies to judge whether two categorical variables are associated.

notes: Volume 1 holds Modules 1-6; Volume 2 holds Modules 7-11 (from the Tennessee student-edition cover; no national cover listing was found for Course 3, but module titles and order match the national catalog). The work-list ISBNs match the 2020 catalog: Interactive Student Edition Vol. 1 978-0-07-667375-9, Vol. 2 978-0-07-899718-1; Teacher Edition Vol. 1 978-0-07-899724-2, Vol. 2 978-0-07-899177-6. The publisher's Module 4 page titles it 'Linear Relationship and Slope'; the catalog and table of contents use 'Linear Relationships and Slope'. The Oklahoma edition replaces Course 3 with a reordered Pre-Algebra book, so do not use its module numbers. The New Mexico sampler paces Module 4 at 17 days of 45-minute periods. Most lesson descriptions are from general knowledge of the topic.
